🎬 Time Bandits (2024)
​Time Bandits is a fantasy adventure comedy series created by the heavy-hitting comedic trio of Taika Waititi, Jemaine Clement, and Iain Morris. Serving as a modern reimagining of Terry Gilliam’s beloved 1981 cult classic film, the show introduces viewers to Kevin (Kal-El Tuck), an 11-year-old history buff whose passion for the ancient world isolates him from his tech-obsessed parents. Kevin’s mundane life gets flipped upside down when a portal suddenly tears open inside his bedroom wardrobe, throwing him into the company of an eccentric, ragtag group of dimension-hopping thieves.

​Led by the deeply confident yet wonderfully inept Penelope (Lisa Kudrow), this band of outlaws has stolen a mystical map belonging to the Supreme Being, allowing them to travel through space and time to plunder historical treasures. As Kevin reluctantly joins their ranks, he serves as the much-needed historical guide for the clueless group as they escape through various portals. Their episodic escapades take them from the construction of Stonehenge and the fall of Troy to Prohibition-era Harlem and ice-age tundras. However, the stakes quickly escalate into a grand quest to save Kevin’s parents and the entire universe when the malicious entity known as "Pure Evil" (Jemaine Clement) seeks to hunt them down and seize the map for himself.

​Visually ambitious, the show blended nearly 5,000 computer-generated visual effects shots with practical animatronics, creature suits, and miniatures to bring its vast historical epochs to life. Tone-wise, the 2024 adaptation traded the cynical, dark, Python-esque nihilism of the original 1981 film for a gentler, more lighthearted brand of family-friendly absurdity. While critics and audiences generally praised the series for its charming performances and witty humor, the show struggled to secure a massive global viewership, leading to its cancellation by Apple TV+ after just one season in September 2024.

Before he directed this, Enzo Barboni was a cinematographer who had shot Sergio Corbucci's Django, so he knew exactly which Western clichés to roast. 🤌 The beans scene proves that the coolest man in the West isn't the fastest draw, he's the one who never stops eating. Trinity drags in like a lazy drifter, plants himself in front of the pan, and shovels beans straight from the skillet as if the whole gunfight-hungry frontier can wait, and it does. Every other Western hero is all squint and menace, while Terence Hill plays it with a lazy grin and a sleepy calm that make the tough guys look like they're trying too hard. Hill and Bud Spencer became one of cinema's great duos here, and the film was a massive hit in Italy that spawned a sequel and a whole wave of comedy Westerns. It all unfolds across a dusty frontier where the joke is that nothing is worth rushing for except dinner. The West was wild, but Trinity was hungry.
